metadata.description: JR's custom Claude Code plugins: repo tools, Runway infrastructure deployment, cross-model assistants, codebase audits, AI dev workflows, and specialist agents

plugins.name: jr-repo-tools
plugins.description: Adds a JRs repo tools like /go-live-check command for quick code reviews

plugins.name: runway
plugins.description: Comprehensive Runway infrastructure deployment management with agents, commands, and hooks

plugins.name: gemini
plugins.description: Cross-model AI assistant via Google Gemini CLI for plan verification, QA review, context offloading, and cross-validation

plugins.name: audit-code
plugins.description: Read-only codebase audit suite: a master orchestrator plus seven focused dimension skills (security, correctness, performance, quality, architecture, dependencies, testing) that render a styled HTML report

plugins.name: ai-developer
plugins.description: AI-assisted development workflow suite: plan and run sprints (mini-sprint), ship the next GitHub issue in an isolated worktree with auto-merge (next-issue), and generate issue reports with burndown tracking (issue-report)

plugins.name: lang-specialists
plugins.description: Senior language and framework specialist agents: fastapi-developer, node-specialist, react-specialist, rust-engineer, typescript-pro, and vue-expert

plugins.name: devops-agents
plugins.description: DevOps and platform agents: terraform-agent (HCP Terraform workflows via bundled Terraform MCP server), github-actions-expert (secure CI/CD workflows), owasp-compliance (OWASP ASI Top 10 agent security checks), and api-architect (layered API client code generation)
